chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:

Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, established brotherhood between the souls in the realm of shadows two thousand years before He created the bodies. Then, when our Qa'im from the Ahl al-Bayt, peace be upon them, rises, he will give inheritance to the brother with whom brotherhood was established between them in the realm of shadows, and he will not give inheritance to the brother through birth.

key_terms.الْأَظِلَّةِ: the realm of shadows where souls were joined before bodily creation
key_terms.الْوِلَادَةِ: birth lineage or natural kinship by birth
key_terms.قَائِمُنَا أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: our Qa'im from the Ahl al-Bayt, peace be upon them

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the brotherhood of souls and inheritance under the Qa'im?
ai.summary: The hadith states that Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, established bonds between souls in the realm of shadows before the creation of bodies. It further describes that when the Qa'im from the Ahl al-Bayt, peace be upon them, rises, inheritance will be assigned according to that prior spiritual brotherhood rather than mere birth relationship.
